title: Miami: Private City Tour with Little Havana & Wynwood Stops
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Unlike group tours, this tour is completely private, which means that the guide and the vehicle will be dedicated only to you and your companions.

During the tour you can visit iconic neighborhoods, stop for pictures and enjoy detailed explanations about each place you visit.

It’s an excellent choice for first-time travelers to Miami or for those who want to re-discover the city in more depth.

As this is a private activity, remember that you can customize your Tour as you wish. Making an extra stop or skipping one is as easy as requesting it from your driver/guide, it is recommended to follow the itinerary so you can have a complete experience, however you can customize it to suit your desires.
